name: Dropp Payments For Member Press
author: Dropp Payment App

sections.description:
Dropp Payment Gateway For Member Press is a WordPress plugin that integrates the Dropp payment gateway with Member Press, allowing your users to make payments via Dropp for memberships, subscriptions, paywall access and LMS.

Features:

  • Seamless integration with Member Press.
  • Secure payment processing with Dropp.
  • Easy setup and configuration.

External Services

This plugin integrates with the “PaymentAPI” to process payments securely. This is needed to handle transactions when users make purchases via the plugin.

It sends the following data:
– User’s billing information and payment details are sent when the user initiates a purchase.
– The data is sent to the PaymentAPI when a transaction is processed to ensure payment completion.

This service is provided by “PaymentAPI”:
– Terms of Use
– Privacy Policy

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dropp-member-press directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Restrict Content Pro settings to configure the Dropp payment gateway for Member Press.
  4. Add [dropp_payment_rcp] shortcode on Thankyou Page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an API key?

Yes, you need a Dropp API key to process payments. You can obtain it from your Dropp merchant account.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest version of WordPress?

Yes, the plugin is tested with the latest version of WordPress.

What version of PHP is required?

This plugin requires PHP 7.2 or higher.
